description: Executable checks only. Responsibility profiles live in ai-staff.json; execution limits live in ai-config.json. Each check has exactly one accountable owner.

audits.title: Staff configuration & workflow integrity
audits.why: A broken or contradictory facility cannot safely coordinate changes.
audits.remediation: Repair invalid configuration, missing references or workflow integrity errors; run the staff regression suite.

audits.title: Catalogue coherence
audits.why: A tool that is missing from the index cannot be discovered.
audits.remediation: Reconcile card fragments and index metadata without deleting existing tools; use the canonical generator.

audits.title: Measured public tool counts
audits.why: Published catalogue figures must come from current data.
audits.remediation: Use python3 scripts/sync-counts.py; never hand-edit counts or rewrite historical entries.

audits.title: Crawlable route inventory
audits.why: Generated discovery routes must match the tracked indexable pages.
audits.remediation: Review the indexable page set and regenerate with python3 scripts/build-sitemap.py.

audits.title: Card JavaScript syntax
audits.why: A syntax error can leave a rendered tool completely inert.
audits.remediation: Fix the reported script blocks; preserve the shared-DOM IIFE boundary and test the actual tool.

audits.title: Real loader & retry regression tests
audits.why: Load, retry and scroll behaviours need executable regression coverage.
audits.remediation: Reconcile tests with the shipped loader, distinguish stale extraction from a runtime defect, and prove loading/retry behaviour in a browser.

audits.title: Card network-exception audit
audits.why: User inputs must not silently leave the device. This static scanner is a subset, not a privacy certification.
audits.remediation: Make new network use local or obtain a reviewed, visible exception; inspect dynamic URLs and offline failure states manually.

audits.title: Product separation & claim review
audits.why: Existing cross-promotion and absolute claims must be surfaced without silently reversing owner policy.
audits.remediation: Review the reported links/claims against CONSTRAINTS.md and staff/DECISIONS.md. Escalate policy conflicts to the owner.

audits.title: Design tokens & accessibility guards
audits.why: Protect the two established design languages; static checks do not measure live geometry or full contrast.
audits.remediation: Restore the reported token or guard without restyling unrelated pages; verify keyboard access, contrast and 360–390px layouts manually.

audits.title: Labels, image text & safe links
audits.why: Broken label associations and unsafe links undermine otherwise useful tools.
audits.remediation: Repair the reported associations, alternative text and rel attributes; test keyboard and screen-reader names.

audits.title: Page metadata scan
audits.why: Missing titles block this check; incomplete metadata remains visible as advisory findings.
audits.remediation: Fix missing titles first, then prioritise indexable pages with missing canonical/social metadata. Do not enrich deliberate noindex scratch pages blindly.

audits.title: Listener entry-point contract
audits.why: The music hub needs an identifiable artist, canonical route and an intentional player-loading contract.
audits.remediation: Restore the music-hub contract using verified IDs in ARCHITECTURE.md §4. Manually verify playback; the static audit never counts views or plays music.

audits.title: Financial arithmetic & honest claims
audits.why: Previously unwired financial tests must be visible, including stale tests that need reconciliation.
audits.remediation: Triage each assertion against the current card, repair genuine formula defects with sourced test vectors, and update stale test extraction only with evidence.
